scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class, from the Common Data Set. Residency rows (in-state 1,233 / out-of-state 5,410 / international 3,913 applicants; 416 / 2,587 / 286 admitted; 96 / 541 / 59 enrolled) add up to the totals (10,556 / 3,289 / 696). The ED figures (937 applications, 356 admitted) cover Early Decision. Test scores are optional: 27% of enrolled first-years (186) submitted the SAT and 9% (60) the ACT. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (the 1.0-1.99 and below-1.0 bands were 0.00%). Undergraduate enrollment (2,675) and the nonresident count (186) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B2.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 as listed in the 2025-26 Common Data Set (G1, G5): tuition $70,486, required fees $1,110, food and housing $20,896 (housing $12,968 + food $7,928). Estimated expenses for residents: books $1,000, transportation $250, other $500 (other costs shown = transportation + other). The CDS prints no total, so none is shown. Per-credit-hour charge $675. Aid figures (H6, 2025-26 estimated): 111 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional need-based or non-need-based aid, average $64,791 (total $7,191,808).
